CardDescription.DefaultText:
A nutritious liquid. Expires into curdled milk.

Can be used to make cheese and butter.

CardHelpSection.DefaultText:
Experies into curdled milk, which can be pressed to make cheese.

Its cream can be extracted to make butter.
